title: Future of US Sports Investment
description:
Bloomberg Businessweek Daily is live from Power Players in New York City, a sports-focused event hosted by Bloomberg's own Vanessa Perdomo-Maglione and Randall Williams. Gotham FC lead Owner and Governor Carolyn Tisch Blodgett discusses how the sports investment landscape has evolved. Plus, 'The Deal' Podcast co-host Jason Kelly talks about the rising popularity of tennis and attention on the US Open. Finally, Bloomberg Managing Editor of Media & Entertainment Lucas Shaw discusses how steaming channels like Amazon and Apple are reshaping their sports strategy.
